page.heading: About this browser
page.introPurpose: Find where to publish, what a deal covers, and what it costs.
page.introLegacy: It is a modernisation of the <link>WUR journal browser</link>, rebuilt on fully open data and released as open source. You can self-host it.
page.introPolicy: For open access policy questions, use the library links under Contact below.

degraded.title: Some data sources are currently degraded

sources.heading: Data sources
sources.tableCaption: Data sources, what each provides, and when its data was last refreshed
sources.pure: Publication counts per journal from the institution's research information system. This is the primary figure, and OpenAlex cross-checks it.
sources.openalex: Journal records, open access status, and citation metrics. It also cross-checks the Pure publication counts.
sources.doaj: The authoritative registry for gold and diamond open access. Whether a journal charges an APC decides gold versus diamond, and the journal URL from DOAJ is the canon homepage. The harvest reads DOAJ's full journal CSV.
sources.openaire: Alternative records and open access links for individual institutional works.
sources.crossref: DOI metadata used to match institutional works to their journal.
sources.openaccessNl: Deal terms, conditions, and workflow descriptions.
sources.jct: Journal lists for transformative agreements, one input to the deal register.
sources.openapc: APC price aggregates and per-article cost evidence.
sources.jiscOpf: Policies for green open access, also called self-archiving. They say which article version a publisher allows to be archived where, and under which licence and embargo.
sources.scimago: SJR indicator, best quartile, and SJR h-index.
sources.footnote: Harvest jobs run when the library refreshes the data. Per-run status is listed below. The deal register is maintained by hand, so a re-ingest cannot overwrite reviewed deal information.
sources.statsWindow: Publication statistics cover works published in {window} or later. The search lists journals with more than 3 publications in that window.

harvests.heading: Harvest runs
harvests.tableCaption: Most recent harvest runs per source, entity, and filter set, with status and finish time
harvests.footnote: Rows for deal sources are historical. The deal register has been maintained by hand since October 2026.
